name: Aniyome Sex ~Ore ni Dakareru Eroi Gishi to no Ecchi Seikatsu~
original_name: 兄嫁セックス ～俺に抱かれるエロい義姉とのエッチ生活～
source:
Minato Kusaka lost his parents at a young age and grew up living with his older brother, Jin. While his life was somewhat lonely, he lived comfortably thanks to the house left behind by their parents and Jin’s support.

Time passed, and Jin entered the workforce and eventually brought home a wife.

Her name was Akari—a bright and kind woman. To Minato, she and his somewhat blunt but hardworking brother seemed like a perfect match.

Minato and Akari eventually became close, maintaining the appropriate boundaries of a sister-in-law and brother-in-law. With Akari in the picture, daily life at the Kusaka household flowed peacefully.

Until he noticed one particular problem.

"You see, I'm feeling... frustrated."

"Because a person's character and good sex are two completely different matters."

...Excuse me?

"So, would you mind helping me out just a little bit? ♪"

Wait, isn't my sister-in-law acting a bit different than usual...?

translation:
久坂凑年幼丧生双亲，自小与哥哥仁相依为命地长大。日子虽然有些孤单，但靠着父母留下的房产与哥哥的扶持，他的生活倒也安稳无忧。

时光流逝，步入社会的仁终成家室，将一位妻子迎进了家门。

嫂子名叫明里——是个开朗又温柔的女性。在凑看来，她与略显木讷却勤恳踏实的哥哥简直是天造地设的一对。

凑与明里很快也熟络起来，始终保持着小叔子与嫂子之间恰如其分的分寸。有了明里的加入，久坂家的日常生活平静而温馨地流淌着。

直到凑察觉到了某桩非同小可的烦恼。

“其实呀，嫂子我现在……欲求不满呢。”

“毕竟人品好不好，跟床上功夫行不行完全是两码事嘛。”

……您说什么？

“所以呀，能不能稍微帮嫂子解决一下呢？♪”

等等，嫂子今天的样子是不是和平时有点不太一样……？
